label: Medusa v2 single backend (vanilla routes on one origin)
description: Point hosts.default at a standard Medusa 2 server (e.g. localhost:9000). For UnifiedCommerce's unifiedcommerce-store, GET /store/products|collections|categories|product-variants returns 410 by design — use preset medusa-v2 only against a backend without that middleware, or expect those tests to fail.
